Desmond Bane scored the Magic's first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 25 times in 88 starts, or 28% of the games they started. Wendell Carter Jr. was next with 19. The Magic made the game's first field goal in 57% of their 88 games and won 72% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
